title: Identity check
intro: Payments above {{amount}}, and adding more than {{amount}} in a day, need a verified identity. This is a sandbox check: use a made-up document, never a real one.

statusText.NONE: Run the check below to make larger payments.
statusText.VERIFIED: You can make payments above the limit.
statusText.REVIEW: A person at the licensed partner would look at this check. In the sandbox nobody does, so run the check again with matching details.
statusText.REJECTED: The check did not pass. See the reasons and try again.

documentFooter: Enter a made-up document. The name must match the name on your Kassa account.
livenessFooter: A real check films your face. Here you choose what the simulated step reports.
invalid: Check the fields: a number of 6 to 20 letters or digits, a two-letter country and dates as YYYY-MM-DD.

reason.DOCUMENT_NUMBER_INVALID: The document number is not valid.
reason.DATE_OF_BIRTH_INVALID: The date of birth is not valid.
reason.NAME_MISMATCH: The name does not match the name on your account.
reason.NAME_PARTIAL_MATCH: The name only partly matches the name on your account.
reason.MANUAL_REVIEW: This document needs a manual review.

privacy: Kassa keeps only the outcome, the document type and country, and the last 4 characters of the number. Never the full number, your date of birth or a photo.
partner: In production a licensed partner runs this check.
